name: The A11Y Project
summary: Community-driven site making digital accessibility easier: WCAG checklist, posts and a resource directory.
description: A community-driven project with a WCAG-based accessibility checklist for levels A and AA, blog posts and topic collections (ARIA, semantic HTML, color contrast …), spotlight interviews with practitioners, and a directory of tools, books, videos, podcasts and newsletters. For designers and developers learning to build accessible sites.
